description: This file declares the Client class within the rialto::servermanager::ipc namespace, which manages IPC communication for the server manager component. It includes method declarations for connecting, setting state and configuration, pinging, setting log levels, and handling disconnection events, along with private methods for handling specific events. The class interacts with external IPC channels, session manager, and event classes.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Manages IPC client operations for the server manager, including connection, configuration, and event handling.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Client with session manager, server ID, and socket.

methods.name: performSetConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with initial state, socket name, display name, resource limits, and permissions.

methods.name: performPing
methods.description: Sends a ping with specified ID.
